sections.kicker: Prepared for Zenith Caffè by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new guest would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Zenith has 48K followers and four cafés. The bio reads like every brunch spot in Lisbon.
sections.keep: Your highlight "Our People". It shows the team, which few brunch places bother to do.

pins.why: Brunch culture describes the whole street, not Zenith.
pins.how: Say what a morning at Zenith is that the café next door is not.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Tourists choose by photo and price, and you are one of many.

pins.what: The bio link goes to another brand's page.
pins.why: Your most valuable click lands on a bagel shop's site.
pins.how: Give Zenith its own page and keep sister brands as guests.
pins.label: Your link
pins.cost: Followers learn a second name before they learn yours.

pins.what: Nine highlights mix menus, pets, press and gift cards.
pins.why: Without a clear order nothing tells a guest what Zenith stands for.
pins.how: Lead with the two that show your idea.
pins.label: Your highlights
pins.cost: Guests see a busy café, not a brand.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Zenith, and you said you want to look like the brand you are. I spent time on your Instagram. Three things stood out.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Zenith Caffè's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Blue Bottle, from coffee. One idea about care, held across every café and cup.
